ModMetaData.name: CE RaidersPlaceSandbags
ModMetaData.author: TSA
ModMetaData.description: Combat Extended version of RaidersPlaceSandbags. NPC pawns place temporary sandbags when shooting matching weapons (defaults target LMGs / CE machine guns). Hostiles always; neutrals and allies optional in settings (on by default). Player pawns never place sandbags. Vanilla (non-CE) version: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3647607090
